stem_md: 设 $f(x,y)$ 为连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^1dy\int_{-\sqrt{2-y^2}}^0f(x,y)dx$ 的积分次序[\quad]
search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 为连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^1dy\int_{-\sqrt{2-y^2}}^0f(x,y)dx$ 的积分次序[\quad] $\int_{-\sqrt2}^{-1}dx\int_0^{\sqrt{2-x^2}}f(x,y)dy+\int_{-1}^0dx\int_0^1f(x,y)dy+\int_0^1dx\int_x^1f(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-\sqrt2}^{0}dx\int_0^1f(x,y)dy+\int_0^1dx\int_0^1f(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-\sqrt2}^{-1}dx\int_0^{\sqrt{2-x^2}}f(x,y)dy+\int_{-1}^0dx\int_0^1f(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-\sqrt2}^{-1}dx\int_0^{\sqrt{2-x^2}}f(x,y)dy+\int_{-1}^0dx\int_x^1f(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_{-\sqrt{2}}^{-1}dx\int_0^{\sqrt{2-x^2}}f(x,y)dy+\int_{-1}^0dx\int_0^1f(x,y)dy+\int_0^1dx\int_x^1f(x,y)dy$。
